scripts.backend:stop: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$isBackendCmd = { param([string]$cmd) if (-not $cmd) { return $false }; return ($cmd -like '*backend/server.js*') -or ($cmd -like '*backend\server.js*') }; $targets = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and (& $isBackendCmd ([string]$_.CommandLine)) }; if ($targets) { foreach ($p in $targets) { Stop-Process -Id $p.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('Stopped backend node process PID ' + $p.ProcessId + '.') } } else { Write-Host 'No backend node process matched command line.' }; while ($true) { $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $conn) { Write-Host 'Port 3000 is free.'; exit 0 }; $proc = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId = ' + $conn.OwningProcess) | Select-Object -First 1; if ($proc -and $proc.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and (& $isBackendCmd ([string]$proc.CommandLine))) { Stop-Process -Id $proc.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host ('Stopped listener backend PID ' + $proc.ProcessId + '.'); continue }; if ($proc) { Write-Host ('Port 3000 is used by non-backend process: ' + $proc.Name + ' (PID ' + $proc.ProcessId + ').'); exit 1 }; Write-Host 'Found listener but could not resolve owning process.'; exit 1 }"
scripts.backend:safe: npm run backend:stop && npm run backend
